If sentiment is >0.5 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is above 70, cap forecast at +1% deviation for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is >68, subtract 0.5–1.5% for early horizon to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is >0.5 and forecast is below 65, add 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon to capture bullish momentum.  
If sentiment is <0.3 and forecast is below 65, add 0.5–1.5% for late horizon to avoid premature bearish correction.
